name: twilio-agents-for-beginners-project
description: An agent hits an irreversible decision, texts a human, and calls when the text goes unanswered.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm start --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
scripts.practice: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run practice --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
